verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official MCP server (docs.stripe.com/mcp) that exposes tools for AI agents to interact with the Stripe API and search documentation, with human-approval gating for sensitive write actions, and this is corroborated by a live probe confirming the endpoint. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on verification of the MCP server itself (community evidence discusses adjacent protocols like MPP/ACP but not direct experience using the Stripe MCP server) and detail on connection/auth setup steps.
